source.source_text: Purpose: execute one allowlisted named task profile such as test/build; no arbitrary command string. Input: profile:string, cwd:string, args?:string[], async?:boolean. Output: result or broker job_id, bounded stdout/stderr, exit class, verification. Contract: L2 writes_local; scope mac.task.run; target task_profile; timeout max 600000ms; cap 2MiB; network/profile-defined; filesystem/profile-defined; minimal env and secret-env denial; approval trusted_profile; non-idempotent unless profile declares otherwise. Phase 3 planned.
